bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
BRANCH="fix/operation-help-current-menu-20261114"
EXPECTED="1c82a37671737af34b6db5cb960915868f876dc0"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/gaybbs-menu-20261115"
printf 'ACTION=BUILD_GAYBBS_MENU_CANDIDATE\n'
git fetch --no-tags origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
if [ -e "$WT" ]; then
  test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
  test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
else
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/.worktrees"
  git worktree add --detach "$WT" "$EXPECTED"
fi
test -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs"
test -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}' | grep -qx true
docker build -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 "$WT" >/dev/null
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 >/dev/null
printf 'MENU_CANDIDATE_BUILT=PASS\nSOURCE_SHA=%s\n' "$EXPECTED"
